sentences.text:
On 05.01.2023 following order was passed:-
"A prayer for adjournment is being made on behalf of learned counsel for the petitioner.
We find that on last two occasions also, the case was adjourned on the request of learned counsel for the petitioner.
Put up this case as fresh on 20.02.2023."
Today, again no one is present to press this petition.
Accordingly, The petition stands dismissed for want of prosecution.
